annual_rate.notes: Connecticut General Statutes §37-3a permits a court to award prejudgment interest of up to 10% per year as damages for detention of money after it becomes payable; the percentage and award are discretionary rather than an automatic 10%. For debt arising from hospital services, both prejudgment and postjudgment interest are capped at 5% and remain discretionary. Verify entitlement and the court-selected rate; not legal advice.
